sn48.54:1.1: Seyyathāpī bhikkhave yāni kānici jaṅgalānam pāṇānam padajatāni sabbāni tāni hatthipade samodhānaṃ gacchanti || hatthipadaṃ tesam aggam akkhāyati yad idam mahantattena ||
sn48.54:1.2: evam eva kho bhikkhave yāni kānici padāni bodhāya saṃvattanti paññindriyaṃ tesam aggam akkhāyati yadidam bodhāya || || 3.
sn48.54:1.3: Katamāni ca bhikkhave padāya bodhāya saṃvattanti || ||
sn48.54:1.4: Saddhindriyam bhikkhave padaṃ tam bodhāya saṃvattati ||
sn48.54:1.9: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave yāni kānici jaṅgalānam pāṇānam padajatāni sabbāni tāni hatthipade samodhānam gacchanti || hatthipadaṃ tesam aggam akkhayati yad idam mahantattena ||
sn48.54:1.10: evam eva kho bhikkhave yāni kānici pādāni bodhāya saṃvattanti || paññindriyam padaṃ tesam aggam akkhāyati yad idam
